sql.where:
T.swjgdm like #{swjgdm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
and (T.nsrsbh = #{qybs,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or T.qyhgdm = #{qybs,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or T.nsrmc like '%' || #{qybs,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
and T.sbywb = #{sbywb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and T.sssq >= #{sssqStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and #{sssqEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} >= T.sssq
and exists (select 1 from ${dbUserBjts}doc_fileinfo df where ((df.nsrdzdah = T.nsrdzdah and df.busitype = 'sbxx' and df.busikey = T.sbid) or (df.nsrsbh = T.nsrsbh and df.busitype = 'qyscba')) and df.filetype = '1' and df.crtime >= #{yxscrqq})
and exists (select 1 from ${dbUserBjts}doc_fileinfo df where ((df.nsrdzdah = T.nsrdzdah and df.busitype = 'sbxx' and df.busikey = T.sbid) or (df.nsrsbh = T.nsrsbh and df.busitype = 'qyscba')) and df.filetype = '1' and #{yxscrqz} + numtodsinterval(1,'day') > df.crtime)
and exists (select 1 from ${dbUserBjts}doc_fileinfo df where ((df.nsrdzdah = T.nsrdzdah and df.busitype = 'sbxx' and df.busikey = T.sbid) or (df.nsrsbh = T.nsrsbh and df.busitype = 'qyscba')) and df.filetype = '1')
and not exists (select 1 from ${dbUserBjts}doc_fileinfo df where ((df.nsrdzdah = T.nsrdzdah and df.busitype = 'sbxx' and df.busikey = T.sbid) or (df.nsrsbh = T.nsrsbh and df.busitype = 'qyscba')) and df.filetype = '1')

mapper.select: select id,nsrdzdah, title,filesize,fmcode,note,crtime as yxscrq,nsrsbh from ${dbUserBjts}doc_fileinfo where ((nsrdzdah = #{nsrdzdah,jdbcType=BIGINT} and busitype = 'sbxx' and busikey = #{sbid,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (nsrsbh = #{nsrsbh} and busitype = 'qyscba')) and filetype = '1'

select hw.xh as mxxh,fp.fphm,fp.kprq, fp.xsfnsrsbh as xfsbh,fp.xsfmc as xfmc,fp.xhfdz||' '||fp.xhflxdh as xfdzdh,fp.xf_nsryh||' '||fp.xf_nsryhzh as xfyhzh, fp.gmfnsrsbh as gfsbh,fp.gmfmc as gfmc,fp.gmfdz||' '||fp.gmflxdh as gfdzdh,fp.gf_nsryh||' '||fp.gf_nsryhzh as gfyhzh, fp.hjje as je,fp.hjse as se,fp.jshj,fp.bz,fp.kpr,fp.skrxm as skr,fp.fhrxm as fhr,fp.fppz_dm,fp.sflzfp, hw.sphfwssflhbbm,hw.hwhyslwfwmc as hwmc,hw.ggxh,hw.dw, hw.fpspsl as sl,hw.fpspdj as dj,hw.je as hw_je,hw.sl_1 as slv,hw.se as hw_se, null as fpzt_dm,'数电发票' as fplx from gt4_yyzc_zr_sjtb.dzfp_kpyw_fpjcxxb fp inner join gt4_yyzc_zr_sjtb.dzfp_kpyw_fpmxxxb hw on hw.fphm=fp.fphm where fp.fphm=#{zyfpNo} order by hw.xh

select substr(ckbgdh, 1, 18) as entryId, hgqy_dm as cnsnTradeScc, jydwmc as consignorCname, HGGQKA_DM as iEPort, HGGQKA_DM as iEPortName, CKRQ_1 as iEDate, HGCKHWBGDSBRQ as dDate, BAH as manualNo, '' as consigneeEname, YSFS_DM as cusTrafMode, YSFS_DM as cusTrafModeName, (YSGJMC || ' ' || HCH) as trafName, TYDH as billNo, HZDWDM as ownerScc, HZDWMC as ownerName, JGFS_DM as supvModeCdde, JGFS_DM as supvModeCddeName, ZMXZ_DM as cutMode, ZMXZ_DM as cutModeName, XKZH as licenseNo, CKHTH as contrNo, MYGDQSZ_DM as cusTradeNationCode, MYGDQSZ_DM as cusTradeNationCodeName, ZZMDGDQSZ_DM as cusTradeCountry, ZZMDGDQSZ_DM as cusTradeCountryName, ZYG_DM as distinatePort, ZYG_DM as distinatePortName, HGGQKA_DM as despPortCode, HGGQKA_DM as despPortCodeName, HGBZZL_DM as wrapType, HGBZZL_DM as wrapTypeName, JS_1 as packNo, MZ_2 as grossWt, JZ as netWt, HGCJFS_DM as transMode, HGCJFS_DM as transModeName, (YFHGHBSZ_DM || ' ' || YFHL) as yfZh, (BFHGHBSZ_DM || ' ' || BFHL) as bfZh, (ZFHGHBSZ_DM || ' ' || ZFHL) as zfZh, '' as attaDocuCdstr, BSM as markNo, LXBZ as noteS from hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 t where djxh = #{djxh} and ckbgdh like #{ckbgdh} || '%' and rownum = 1

select substr(ckbgdh, 19, 21) as gNo, CKSP_DM as codeTs, nvl(HGSPMC,CKSPMC) as gName, GGXH as gModel, CKSL as qty1, DYJLDW_DM as unit1Name, DECKSL as qty2, DEJLDW_DM as unit2Name, SBSL_1 as gQty, SBJLDW_DM as gUnitName, SBDJ as declPrice, CJZJ as declTotal, CJHGHBSZ_DM as tradeCurrName, MYGDQSZ_DM as cusOriginCountryName, ZZMDGDQSZ_DM as destinationCountryName, HZDWDQ_DM as districtCodeName, ZMXZ_DM as dutyModeName from hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 t where djxh = #{djxh} and ckbgdh like #{ckbgdh} || '%'
